content.value_statement: Belgian residential rental documents depend on regional rules, lease details, and energy ratings. This guide helps an AI assistant prepare structured drafts for human review.
actual_capabilities: Guide AI drafting of nine-year, short-term, and student residential lease outlines.
Frame rent indexation requests around region, lease dates, energy ratings, and manually supplied Statbel data.
Guide drafting of notices for personal occupancy, renovation, or tenant termination.
Support structured move-in and move-out property inspection checklists.
Provide context for explaining MyRent registration workflows.
Request rental document drafts in Markdown format.
limitations: The package contains only a Markdown guide; original scripts, extension source, and document templates are not included.
Statbel index values require manual lookup; no live data connection or automatic registration integration is provided.
Commercial and common law leases are excluded.
Legal updates and the sample calculation are not independently verified; all documents and financial results require human review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Residential Lease Outline
use_cases.description: Draft a region-specific residential lease outline and identify missing facts before obtaining legal review.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Indexation Letter
use_cases.description: Organize verified index values, lease dates, and regional requirements into a draft rent indexation letter.

use_cases.title: Standardize Inspection Notes
use_cases.description: Prepare consistent move-in and move-out inspection checklists with sections for condition, meter readings, and photographs.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Inspection Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Markdown move-in inspection checklist for an apartment in [Belgian region]. Include rooms, meter readings, keys, photographs, and signature placeholders.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: prepare a structured inspection draft.

prompt_templates.title: Outline a Residential Lease
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a [lease type] residential lease outline for [Belgian region] using [anonymized details]. Mark missing facts and clauses requiring legal review.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Indexation Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an indexation letter using [region], [lease dates], [base rent], [energy rating], and [verified Statbel values]. Explain assumptions and flag unverified correction rules.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine supplied financial data with a reviewable letter.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Termination Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a termination notice draft for [region], [lease type], [dates], and [reason]. List missing evidence and legal questions. Do not invent deadlines or eligibility.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a notice for professional review.

output_examples.input: Create a move-in inspection checklist for a Brussels apartment.
output: Property details: address placeholder, inspection date, and participating parties.
Room condition: walls, ceilings, floors, windows, fixtures, and existing damage.
Utilities and access: meter readings, key counts, and photograph references.
Review: unresolved observations and signature placeholders.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Ghent rent indexation letter for an EUR 850 lease starting in March 2024, without verified indices.
output: Status: draft only; no revised rent calculated.
Missing inputs: signing date, indexation date, verified Statbel indices, and energy rating.
Verification required: applicable regional eligibility rules and any correction factor.
Letter draft: tenant and property placeholders, verified calculation section, effective date placeholder, and landlord signature.

best_practices: Provide the property region, lease type, signing date, start date, and energy rating before requesting calculations or notices.
Use official Statbel values and verify regional rules independently; do not reuse the example values without checking them.
Use anonymized details during drafting and obtain qualified review before signing, registering, or sending documents.
anti_patterns: Treating generated drafts as guaranteed legal advice or automatically compliant documents.
Reusing the sample indices, correction factor, or rent amount without independent verification.
Expecting automatic MyRent submission, live Statbel retrieval, or bundled document generation software.

faq.question: Which Belgian regions does the guide cover?
faq.answer: It discusses residential rental workflows in Flanders, Brussels, and Wallonia. Verify the current rules for the property location.

faq.question: Does this package include scripts or document templates?
faq.answer: No. The available package contains SKILL.md only; the guide states that original scripts, extension source, and templates are absent.

faq.question: Does it retrieve current Statbel index values?
faq.answer: No live retrieval is provided. Look up official values manually and supply verified figures with the relevant lease dates.

faq.question: Can I use the output without legal review?
faq.answer: No. The guide requires human review. Check current legislation, notice periods, eligibility, and calculations before using any draft.

faq.question: Does it support commercial leases?
faq.answer: No. Commercial and common law leases are explicitly excluded from the stated scope.

faq.question: Does it register a lease through MyRent?
faq.answer: No automated registration is included. The guide discusses the workflow, but users must complete and verify registration themselves.
